optimal_policy/OSR/osr_example_obj_corr_.note: The OSR objective is identical: at Dynare's optimal rules pydyn's loss is 3.334309582956127 against Dynare's 3.33430958295605, and at the initial values 8.025573444649 against 8.025573444647 (2e-13 relative). The csminwel paths agree in the first 17 iterations (f at the start of each iteration to 1e-3 or better, the same lambda sequences in the iterations compared in detail); a rounding-level difference in the objective (1e-12) is amplified by the long, nearly flat valley of the non-stationary model (a lambda=27 step turns 4e-10 into 2e-7 in f at iteration 7, 1e-3 at 18), then the paths part. Dynare takes 164 iterations, perturbs the search direction at two cliffs (iterations 46 and 84, with its own rand stream) and ends at 3.3343 (exit 3); pydyn stops at 44 iterations at 3.3665 (crit 1e-7). Perturbing the objective by 2e-13 relative moves pydyn's end point between 3.3639 and 3.3665, so the end point is not reproducible; dr, moments and IRFs are evaluated there
